beats.summary: Michael and Dwight argue over the Sebring car, leading to Michael asserting ownership and Dwight begging not to be fired.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well, I guess it's time, that I turn over the keys, to the famous Sebring.

beats.summary: Michael and Dwight reconcile after the confrontation with a hug, though Michael remains somewhat angry and punishes Dwight.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You can get up. Get up. And you can hug it out, bitch.
Michael: Yep. Yeah, we hugged it out. But, it turns out, I was still a little angry.

beats.summary: Dwight suggests cost-cutting measures to Michael, including firing Meredith and charging Creed rent, which Michael rejects.
Creed reveals he sleeps under his desk four nights a week and stays in Toronto three nights, hiding his other job.

evidence.snippet: Creed: Four nights a week, I sleep under my desk, and then three nights I stay at my place in Toronto.

beats.summary: Michael tries to resume Movie Monday but no one joins, and he ends up playing online Scrabble.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, well, we had scheduled this time to watch a movie together, so I guess I will just go play some online Scrabble.

beats.summary: Jim experiences a different work environment in Stamford, including playful interactions with Jan and Karen.

evidence.snippet: Jim (playing Call of Duty): Oh? Someone's left out in the open, taking a little siesta.
Jim: Things are a little bit… different here in Stamford.
